acceptance.given: The atomic-obligation set and its obligation-to-witness mappings are loaded for Exact Cover validation.

oracle.expected: The validation artifact reports bidirectional Exact Cover coverage for 100% of atomic obligations and zero orphan obligations.
forbidden: Any atomic obligation lacks a bidirectional Exact Cover relationship.
Exact Cover exists in only one direction.
oracle.observable: The Exact Cover validation result records a bidirectional relationship for every atomic obligation.

acceptance.then: The validator emits a complete bidirectional Exact Cover result covering every atomic obligation.
acceptance.when: The Exact Cover validator executes against the loaded atomic-obligation set.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the Exact Cover validator with at least one atomic obligation missing a reverse relationship or witness and observe the runtime validation marker.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Ensure Exact Cover validation emits a complete bidirectional coverage result for every atomic obligation and identifies orphan or one-way mappings.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing Exact Cover validator inputs and result schema; revert only the validator behavior and its targeted test.

slice_hint.state_transition: Uncovered or one-way atomic mappings become an explicit validation failure; complete mappings produce a bidirectional coverage artifact.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The validation artifact contains bidirectional coverage entries for every atomic obligation and zero orphan entries.

acceptance.given: The six defined Matrix Cases and their input bindings are prepared for matrix evaluation.

oracle.expected: Execution records show six Matrix Cases executed, with pairwise-distinct input identities for all six cases.
forbidden: Two or more Matrix Cases use the same input.
A Matrix Case lacks an input execution.
oracle.observable: The matrix execution artifact lists six completed case records and six pairwise-distinct input identities.

acceptance.then: The aggregate matrix artifact confirms execution of all six cases with pairwise-distinct inputs.
acceptance.when: The Matrix evaluation executes and records each case input and result.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the matrix evaluator with one duplicated case input or an omitted case and observe rejection of the aggregate.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Record and validate six Matrix Case executions, requiring a distinct input identity for every case and rejecting omissions or collisions.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Keep the existing matrix record format and replay input bindings compatible; revert only distinct-input enforcement changes.

slice_hint.state_transition: Matrix execution moves from unverified case coverage to a six-case artifact with explicit, pairwise-distinct input identities.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The aggregate contains exactly six executed Matrix Cases and no duplicate input identity.

acceptance.given: An adversarial validator case is supplied to the success-evaluation path.

oracle.expected: The adversarial case receives a non-success verdict and the evaluation artifact records the rejection reason.
forbidden: Success is accepted for an adversarial validator case.
oracle.observable: The validator evaluation result has a non-success status for the adversarial case.

acceptance.then: The success evaluator rejects the adversarial case and emits a non-success result.
acceptance.when: The adversarial validator case is executed through the toolchain success-evaluation path.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute an adversarial validator case against the success-evaluation path and detect any success verdict or missing rejection artifact.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Ensure adversarial validator inputs cannot produce a success verdict and that rejection is represented in the evaluation artifact.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve replay CLI and evaluation-result compatibility; revert only adversarial-case rejection logic.

slice_hint.state_transition: An adversarial evaluation transitions to an explicit non-success verdict with diagnostic evidence.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The adversarial case result is non-success and includes a rejection reason; no success verdict is emitted.

acceptance.given: A toolchain behavior path is evaluated on a supported platform where behavior may differ by platform.

oracle.expected: The toolchain artifact explicitly declares the platform-specific behavior and its applicable platform context.
oracle.observable: The replay or evaluation artifact contains an explicit platform-behavior declaration.

acceptance.then: The resulting toolchain metadata includes a platform-specific behavior declaration.
acceptance.when: The platform-differing behavior path is inspected during replay/evaluation.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Inspect a platform-differing behavior path whose evaluation artifact omits the required platform declaration and observe contract rejection.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Declare platform-specific toolchain behavior in the replay/evaluation artifact whenever behavior differs by platform.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing replay inputs and artifact schema; revert only platform-declaration enforcement.

slice_hint.state_transition: Platform-differing behavior changes from undeclared metadata to an explicit platform declaration in the toolchain artifact.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The inspected artifact contains a non-empty declaration identifying the platform-specific behavior and platform context.
